simple.meaning: שִׁשִּׁים (shishshîym) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “sixty.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 59 times across Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 5:15. Its contexts include family, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁשִּׁים (H8346).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שִׁשִּׁים (shishshîym) / H8346 is traced through Genesis 5:15, Genesis 5:18, Genesis 5:20, Genesis 5:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.
